dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to have my picture taken too...

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: That's no problem, none at all. Just help me deliver the pictures first...

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: There should be names on the back of these... Agh, I must've forgotten to write them down in my hurry.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, but you'll have to try and find them based on the pictures. They're very clear, so you should be able to identify where you need to go at a glance.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Again, thank you. I apologize, but I must attend to other matters...
